title: Initiative Portfolios Heatmap and Dependency Fuse for Company OKR Convergence
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an actionable Initiative Portfolios Heatmap and a lightweight 'Dependency Fuse' process to make cross-functional initiative alignment operational for company-level OKRs. Deliverables: a living heatmap visualization, a triage matrix for staging initiatives into commit lanes, and an escalation/runbook (Dependency Fuse) that standardizes how blocked initiatives surface and are resolved across Eng, Design, and Product.
background: We frequently see feature-level work that claims OKR alignment but lacks cross-team coordination, which causes downstream schedule slips during quarterly delivery. Existing artifacts are fragmented (spreadsheets, ad-hoc slides, and individual team roadmaps). Leadership and platform teams need a single view to prioritize scarce execution capacity and a low-friction mechanism to resolve interlocks before they become blockers.
scope: Scope includes: (1) definition of portfolio-level dimensions (impact, effort, risk, customer-facing ambiguity), (2) a staged heatmap visualization (Backlog / Staging / Committed / At-risk), (3) a lightweight Dependency Fuse runbook and owner-rotation pattern, (4) templates for PRD and roadmap slices to populate the heatmap, and (5) a quarterly handoff ritual integrated with the planning cycle. Excludes: tactical sprint-level story grooming and resource-level hiring forecasts.
acceptance_criteria: Heatmap prototype available in Confluence with data ingestion template and example inputs from Eng/Design/Product
Triage matrix with clear thresholds for moving initiatives between lanes (Backlog, Staging, Committed, At-risk)
Dependency Fuse runbook documented with on-call rotation owners, SLA for resolution steps (48h triage / 7d mitigation plan), and escalation contacts
Two pilot initiatives (one infrastructure, one product-facing) run through the process with retro and improvement notes
Stakeholder sign-off from Head of Product, VP Eng, and Design Director
